BLOCKER: CL-013 not satisfied: design never pins constant-time comparison for PF_ADMIN_TOKEN; no security test for timing-safe compare appears in test_matrix or coverage (security section only says "Admin bearer required").

CL-011 not satisfied: design asserts "RLS enforced" but provides no runtime-role attestation (NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS) and no role/RLS test in the matrix; the counter triggers run under the migrating role, whose posture is unstated.

CL-012 not satisfied: performance section claims "DB timeout 5s" via PF_EDP_DB_TIMEOUT but never pins a DB-level statement_timeout/cancellation or a bound (cap/estimate) on the tenant-scoped COUNT(*) over backlog_items — a client-side ctx timeout alone does not bound DB work.
MAJOR: CL-010 not yet satisfied: all ac_evidence SHA fields are empty; proof_plan only has prose red/green descriptions. Gate 1.5 requires current-run red proof for the real entrypoint, not prose.

0018/0019 add INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE triggers to the backlog_items write path, contradicting the "read-only admin path" rollout claim; a trigger fault can fail or block primary backlog writes. Rollback says "no item data change" but does not bound this write-path blast radius.
No verified backup/restore or migration-interrupted-recovery step is stated before applying 0018/0019 (checklist items 1 and 6); down-migrations exist but no rehearsal/verification is declared.
Design does not explain the delta between migration 0018 and the extra 0019 "hardening" migration; both are in affected_files but only 0016/0018 appear in the AC, risking scope drift.
Ownership gate is explicitly "pending" (CL-001): no single-writer/owner for the global allocation row and counter triggers is named before adding the endpoint.
MINOR: Dependencies list "migrations 0016-0019" (a range) but 0017 is never named, declared, or excluded; prerequisites vs changed files (CL-016) are separated for 0016 but the 0017 position is ambiguous.
Design does not state whether the 405 and 400 responses reuse the existing edpsvc error-body/redaction helpers or define new ones, risking contract drift with other admin routes.

Observability section names "startup/recheck gauge, error counter, success timestamp" but no metric names, labels (tenant?), or cardinality bounds are pinned; tenant-labeled metrics could explode cardinality.
NIT: Runbook file is declared but no runbook sections (detection, triage, escalation) are sketched; acceptable at Gate 1 but should be filled before merge.
Scope-guard test name is long and encodes behavior; consider a data-driven case list for readability.
SUMMARY: Design direction is sound (fail-closed admin readiness endpoint, reuse of BacklogStore, Prometheus + runbook), but it does not satisfy three correction-ledger requirements that are explicit pre-Gate-1.5 conditions: constant-time token compare (CL-013), runtime-role/RLS posture proof (CL-011), and DB-level statement_timeout plus count bound (CL-012).

Secondary risks: trigger-based counter adds write-path blast radius to backlog_items while the design still calls the rollout "read-only"; no backup/restore or migration-interrupted-recovery step is declared; red-proof evidence SHAs are empty.
Recommend fixing CL-011/012/013 and attaching current-run red proof before proceeding to Gate 1.5.
